title: GKIDS Releases 100 Meters Anime Film on Blu-ray Disc on December 1
content: GKIDS announced on Wednesday that it will release the anime film of Uoto 's 100 Meters ( Hyakuemu ) manga on Blu-ray Disc on December 1. The Collector's Edition includes five art cards and a mini-poster. The disc release includes an interview with director Kenji Iwaisawa , a rotoscoping workshop, and scene breakdowns.
author: ANN

title: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 Creditless Opening Featuring FZMZ's "DREAM OF BUTTERFLY" Released
content: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 has released its creditless opening sequence featuring FZMZ’s “DREAM OF BUTTERFLY.” The song was written and composed by MAQUMA and JACK, with arrangement by HONNWAKA88. It was released digitally on October 7.
author: Anime Corner

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Reaches Impressive Streaming Milestone Ahead of Part 2
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle has been taking over the small screen one year after its big screen debut, and it’s hit an impressive new streaming milestone across multiple platforms as fans watch the film in anticipation of its big sequel.

title: Love Through a Prism Anime Gets Novel Adaptation
content: The official X/Twitter account for Shueisha 's Jump J-Books novel imprint announced on Wednesday that the Love Through a Prism ( Prism Rondo ) original anime series from Boys Over Flowers creator Yōko Kamio is getting a two-volume novel adaptation.

title: MediaOCD Announces Deal to Sell Select Aniplex of America Anime on Blu-ray Disc
content: MediaOCD announced on Wednesday a sales agreement with Aniplex of America to sell select anime on Blu-ray Disc on the MediaOCD online store. Initial Aniplex of America titles available on MediaOCD 's website are the Gurren Lagann television series and films, and the two seasons of the Mashle: Magic and Muscles anime.
